## Color validations


We now support color validations based on color groups rather than specific hexadecimal (HEX) codes. This allows users to validate an element’s color without specifying an exact color value.


For example, you can use the following commands:


```text
check that "element" color looks red
check that "element" background color looks blue
check that "element" border color looks purple
check that "element" color doesn't look green
check that "element" background color doesn't look yellow
check that "element" border color doesn't look pink
```


These validations support the following colors:


- white
- yellow
- red
- purple
- pink
- orange
- green
- gray
- brown
- blue
- black


## Variable inspector for Live Mode


We’ve introduced a new Variable Inspector for Live Mode. Whenever variables are created during a Live Mode test session, they will automatically appear in the Variable Inspector, allowing users to easily view and track their values.


## Qase Integration


Test suites can now be integrated with Qase. To enable this integration, navigate to **Settings > Integrations** , locate the Qase integration section, and enable it.


## Setting Camera Images on Mobile Devices


The` set camera image to` command is now supported on testRigor-provided mobile devices.


Previously, this functionality was only available on Sauce Labs devices. With this update, users can now set camera images directly on testRigor’s own emulators.
